freshness_reassessment.interpretation: The 2026-04-15 cohort dropped from 90 to 35 URLs (exactly the 55 T28-retired URLs' removal from the sitemap). In absolute terms, 32 fewer URLs are now stale (159 -> 127). As a PROPORTION of a smaller total corpus, the stale share rose slightly (70% -> ~75%), because the retired pages were themselves part of the stale cohort and their removal shrank the denominator faster than the numerator. Separately and more importantly: none of the 45 STRENGTHEN-treated pages (18 bolt-size, 9 tap-drill, 18 perno, plus reference/standards/asme.html and the 4 T29 pages) had their sitemap lastmod value bumped to reflect their actual T27-T29 content edits -- the sitemap's freshness metadata now understates how recently those specific pages were substantively improved. This was not required by any phase's brief and is noted as an accurate-but-unflattering observation, not a mass-date-change recommendation.
freshness_reassessment.genuinely_stale_vs_stable_content: The remaining stale cohort is a mix of (a) genuinely static reference content (ISO thread series, tolerance definitions) that does not require frequent editing and whose staleness is not a quality problem, and (b) the 9 unstrengthened tap-drill pages plus 17 vs-comparison and remnant legacy pages, which are stale in the same 'one-shot, never revisited' sense T26 originally flagged.
freshness_reassessment.classification: NOT MATERIALLY IMPROVED as a proportion; genuinely improved in absolute stale-page count; a new, minor, honest observation (stale lastmod on strengthened content) was surfaced but is LOW severity.

next_action.rationale: The single CRITICAL finding is fully resolved and both HIGH findings are resolved or materially reduced, verified with fresh, quantitative, current-state evidence rather than assumption. Every remaining unresolved item is individually MEDIUM or LOW severity, small in scope, and either (a) requires a subjective editorial/IA judgment call better made deliberately than as a reflexive follow-on phase (the 9 remaining tap-drill pages; homepage prominence), or (b) is real but trivial in magnitude relative to the overhead of opening another formal Director-controlled implementation phase (the 6g-vs-6h duplicate pair, 2 URLs; sitemap lastmod accuracy). No regression was introduced by T27, T28, or T29. Three consecutive implementation phases have just concluded; the evidence does not show a remaining structural or volume-level problem comparable to what justified them, so further immediate implementation would have diminishing returns relative to its process cost. This conclusion follows option C (remaining issues are individually minor and no immediate implementation is justified), with elements of E (the site has materially improved; the few unresolved risks are already identified and can be handled sequentially, at low urgency, whenever a future phase is opened for another reason).
